description: Drafts a reply (subject and body) to a received e-mail (max 10,000 characters) for an intent: accept, decline, ask-information, follow-up or custom with your own instructions. Tone formal, neutral or friendly; language as requested. Dates, numbers and names that are not in the inputs appear as placeholders such as [date]. Read it before sending. Related tools on this server, for a different need: email_check when you need to check e-mail addresses without sending mail. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

instructions.description: Your own instructions (max 500 characters), required for intent custom

intent.description: accept, decline, ask-information, follow-up or custom

language.description: Language code or name of the reply, default en

name: email_reply
title: Generate a reply to an e-mail for a chosen intent
